text:
aisha (Partnerships): Skylimit asks for AWS Marketplace listing + downloadable model + co-branded appliance. Need alignment on sublicensing and geoblocking.

 tom (Legal): Can vendor grant sublicenses that let HW partners bundle the model? Concern: downstream resale.

 aisha (Partnerships): They want one contract for all three channels.

 rachel (Marketplace): Marketplace requires AMI/container + manifest.json. Downloads ok but must meet packaging spec and SKU separation.

 noah (Eng): Appliance = certified runtime + quant profile. We need checksums + compatibility manifest.

 tom (Legal): Draft clause: Redwood gets non-exclusive sublicense for AMI, portal download, and appliance images. No resale of raw weights to other marketplaces. Vendor must warrant IP rights and provide provenance.

 rachel (Marketplace): Manifest example: {name, formats, runtime_compat, checksums} for automation.

 noah (Eng): I'll make a lightweight harness to run a smoke inference and verify output hash. Vendor must pass before listing.

 onboard-bot: Checklist created for Skylimit. Items: legal redline, packaging spec, eng harness, export review. Due 72h.

 tom (Legal): Add export compliance clause and a vendor checkbox confirming authority to sublicense compiled/quantized artifacts. Include 90-day takedown for IP claims.

 aisha (Partnerships): Marketing cadence suggestion: SI canary (3 partners) -> NA/EU marketplace GA -> appliance public announce. Geoblock downloads in APAC until export sign-off.

 rachel (Marketplace): Need 10 business days after legal sign-off to create listings and SKUs. Appliance billing should be separate transfer-license line item.

 noah (Eng): Support policy: downloadable artifacts get tiered support. Enterprise: SLA; others: community. Include in partner contract.

 aisha (Partnerships): Action items: @tom legal redline (48h), @noah test harness (48h), @rachel manifest + SKU mapping (72h), partnerships PM to draft co-marketing & SI list (72h).

 tom (Legal): Will circulate redline here when ready.

 aisha (Partnerships): Thanks team. Reminder: avoid public phrase "open distribution"  use "downloadable under license" or "partner-deliverable".

 onboard-bot: Checklist updated. Deadlines set.
